name_note: In GTDB this genus also holds genomes deposited at NCBI under the names Prevotellamassilia and Prevotella, so published work using those names may concern members of this group.

sentences.text: Alloprevotella was proposed as a genus of anaerobic, Gram-negative bacilli within the family Prevotellaceae, based on strains isolated from the human oral cavity.
The same description reclassified Prevotella tannerae as Alloprevotella tannerae, which it names as the type species of the genus.
A case report describes Alloprevotella rava, previously described in the human oral cavity, isolated from polymicrobial chronic mandibular osteomyelitis in a 92-year-old woman.
